name: ADR-Bench
intro: ADR-Bench 是面向真实中文深度研究场景的 110 题内部基准。作者调研实际用户与业务需求，由领域专家起草并经多轮测试、过滤和修订，形成 70 个通用题与 40 个金融/法律专业题。通用轨采用盲审人工两两对比和四维质量判断；专业轨采用经专家交叉验证、含负向风险项的枚举式 rubric 自动评分。
build_method: 真实场景调研, 专家起草与多轮修订, 专业Rubric交叉验证
metric: 通用：人工成对偏好/Elo风格评级；专业：Rubric得分
eval_feature: 盲审人工成对偏好, 多维质量, 专业Rubric评测
build_method_en: Real-scenario study, expert drafting and multi-round revision, professional-rubric cross-validation
eval_feature_en: Blind human pairwise preference, multidimensional quality, professional rubric evaluation
intro_en: ADR-Bench is an in-house 110-query benchmark for realistic Chinese deep-research scenarios. The authors study real user and business needs, then have domain experts draft, test, filter, and revise queries into 70 general tasks and 40 finance/law professional tasks. The general track uses blind human pairwise comparison with four quality dimensions; the professional track uses automated scoring against enumerated, expert-cross-validated rubrics with negative risk criteria.
metric_en: General: human pairwise preference/Elo-style rating; professional: rubric score
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2512.20491 Sections 6-7.2. The diagram preserves the 9-domain, 110-query distribution; expert drafting and multi-round filtering/revision; 70 general and 40 finance/law split; five-principle expert rubric construction; 30-turn/16k ReAct limit versus default commercial web settings; blind human five-category comparison across four dimensions; automated professional rubric scoring with negative-risk criteria; and track-specific win/tie/loss, Elo-style, dimension, and rubric outputs.
